<tool_call>
<function=check_solution>
<parameter=original_problem>
Determine the maximum product of any triplet in an array of integers.
</parameter>
<parameter=proposed_solution>
Sort the array and return the product of the last three numbers.
</parameter>
<parameter=input_data>
[-10, -10, 5, 2]
</parameter>
<parameter=solution_output>
The product is 100 (as the sorted array is [-10, -10, 2, 5], and the product of the last three numbers is -10 x 2 x 5 = -100, which is incorrect as the maximum product is -10 x -10 x 5 = 500).
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
